Both figures are company-reported. It is the country's largest single tracked non-state digital commitment, and it is a memorandum.

2026-05 - an accord signed in Beijing by the interior vice-premier and China's public-security minister [gives Chinese technical assistance to the national police naming cybercrime alongside urban crime and mining fraud, with a standing joint working group](2026-05-27-accord-cooperation-policiere-chine-cybercriminalite-actualite). No text, value, equipment or software list, and no data-handling or oversight arrangement is held.

summary: [Over EUR 180m in new EU and Team Europe investments was announced at the Global Gateway Forum on 9 October 2025](2025-10-09-ec-global-gateway-forum-drc-investments).
developments:
[President von der Leyen met President Tshisekedi at the 2025 Global Gateway Forum on 9 October and announced over EUR 180 million in new EU and Team Europe investments across the Kivu-Kinshasa Green Corridor, Lobito Corridor value chains, Kisangani electrification and critical raw materials cooperation](2025-10-09-ec-global-gateway-forum-drc-investments), building on a [2023 memorandum on critical raw materials](2023-10-26-eu-drc-mou-critical-raw-materials).

None of it names digital regulation, data adequacy or a digital governance instrument, and the repository holds no EU financing agreement or delegation statement on any of those.

summary: The digital economy minister [met a Gulf-based delegation on data-centre proposals in February 2026](2026-02-09 DRC steps up talks with foreign firms on data centres and digital infrastructure); talks only.
developments:
2026-02 - the minister [met a Gulf-based delegation on data-centre proposals, with a proposed technical-specification working group and no memorandum, site, capacity or follow-up recorded six months on](2026-02-09 DRC steps up talks with foreign firms on data centres and digital infrastructure).

It is the whole of the relationship as the repository holds it. No investment, agreement or presence has followed, and the working group that was proposed has produced nothing on record, so what is stated is an exploratory meeting rather than a commitment.

progress: No change, the relationship is on the record and its digital content is nil
summary: India's [consolidated brief records instruments from 2008 to 2010, none of them digital](2026-02-23-mea-india-drc-bilateral-brief).
developments:
[India's Ministry of External Affairs brief records a 2008 Joint Commission agreement, a 2009 cultural cooperation agreement, a May 2010 memorandum on regular Foreign Office Consultations, decades of ministerial visits, MONUSCO troop contributions and early signature of the International Solar Alliance Agreement](2026-02-23-mea-india-drc-bilateral-brief).

It is India's own authoritative statement of the relationship's standing state, and it names no digital instrument: no line of credit, training placement or supplier contract touching the digital estate is held.

summary: Anonymised operator call records are being used to [anticipate where the Ebola outbreak will spread](2026-09-03-reuters-drc-ebola-mobile-phone-mobility-flowminder), the first such use in an Ebola response.
developments:
The World Health Organization and the non-profit Flowminder are mapping population movement from anonymised Vodacom records to direct surveillance; the first analysis, published in early June 2026, tracked travel out of Bunia, Mongbwalu and Rwampara between 3 and 23 April, and by end-June all ten largest destination areas had confirmed cases, while a mid-June reading on Kisangani let responders reinforce the river hub before its first case ([Reuters](2026-09-03-reuters-drc-ebola-mobile-phone-mobility-flowminder)).

Coverage is capped at [one operator's roughly 35% market share](2026-09-03-reuters-drc-ebola-mobile-phone-mobility-flowminder) and stops at the border, and no legal basis, consent regime or retention rule for the arrangement is published.

summary: The [2019 plan set four pillars to a 2025 horizon that has now passed](2019-09-01-rdc-plan-national-numerique-horizon-2025); its successor for 2026-2030 [has no finalised published document](2026-07-24-drc-psen-2026-2030-expert-validation).
developments:
The plan of record was [validated at a national workshop in September 2019 under the head of state's authority, on four strategic pillars — infrastructure, content, applicative uses, and governance and regulation](2019-09-01-rdc-plan-national-numerique-horizon-2025). No separate enacting decree was found; the plan records only the decision creating its own validation workshop's organising committee.

Its horizon has passed. The successor plan for 2026-2030 carries an announced envelope of treasury investment over five years plus external partner support, with no finalised published plan document locatable.

2026-08-04 - a sectoral digital economy policy for 2026-2030 was [validated and referred to the council of ministers for adoption, on axes covering infrastructure, digital transformation of the administration, the digital economy, innovation and start-ups, and cybersecurity](2026-08-04-drc-kibassa-launches-digital-economy-policy-and-national-ai-strategy). Seven years after the last adopted plan, what the repository holds is two documents awaiting adoption and one whose term has run out.

summary: No open-data policy instrument exists; a [national open-data platform was launched on 23 February 2026](2026-02-23-rhinoceros-data-gouv-cd-lancement) and an [access-to-information bill is in commission](2026-03-28-proposition-loi-acces-information-recevable-actualite).
developments:
2026-02-23 - the statistics institute [launched a national open-data platform publishing datasets across demography, economy, health, education, public finance, agriculture and infrastructure](2026-02-23-rhinoceros-data-gouv-cd-lancement). A platform is not a policy: no licence, release calendar or publication duty sits behind it.

2026-03-28 - a bill on access to information and transparency in public life was [ruled admissible and sent to commission; it sets access as the norm and limitation the exception, applies to public services and some private actors, and requires a simple, fast and free request procedure alongside proactive publication](2026-03-28-proposition-loi-acces-information-recevable-actualite). It is not enacted.

2026-08-17 - the central bank [relaunched its website as a public economic-data portal carrying exchange rates, inflation, interest rates, statistics and indicators](2026-08-17-numerico-bcc-nouveau-site-donnees-economiques).

Publication is proceeding institution by institution, with no rule requiring any of it and none of the reciprocal work — a state moving the other way on geological data, [vesting it in itself and charging for access](2026-09-08-thecitizen-congo-locks-down-geological-data).

progress: No change, a standing position the repository holds for the first time
summary: The rule is a hosting duty: [the law requires all public-administration data to be hosted in the state data centre, and some data still sits on private servers](2025-07-24-sgptntic-visite-data-center-gouvernement).
developments:
The government's own account of the state data centre records both halves of the position: [the law requires all public-administration data to be hosted there, and some data nonetheless still sits on private servers](2025-07-24-sgptntic-visite-data-center-gouvernement). No compliance figure, migration plan or enforcement action against that duty is published, and the instrument imposing it is not itself held.

The replacement named for it is a [sovereign government cloud, listed as an existing ministry project alongside the digital and data strategies, the identity platform and a certification authority, with no hosting location, operator, procurement, budget line or date](2026-07-29-drc-kibassa-launches-strategic-framework-digital-transformation).

No rule reaches private-sector or personal data at all: nothing states where a bank, an operator or a platform may hold data on Congolese residents.

summary: The [Digital Code of March 2023 covers the security and criminal protection of information systems](2023-03-13-rdc-ordonnance-loi-23-010-code-numerique), and the [national cybersecurity authority was created by ordinance in May 2026](2026-05-16-rdc-ancy-ordonnance-26-033-journal-officiel).
developments:
The statute is one code covering the whole field: [its first article scopes it to digital activities and services, electronic writings and trust-service providers, digital content, and the security and criminal protection of information systems, alongside a digital tax, customs and exchange regime, and its definitions include cybercrime, cybersecurity, electronic commerce, cryptology and interoperability](2023-03-13-rdc-ordonnance-loi-23-010-code-numerique).

2026-05-16 - an ordinance under it [creates the national cybersecurity authority, with powers to audit public institutions and operators of vital importance and to certify cybersecurity products](2026-05-16-rdc-ancy-ordonnance-26-033-journal-officiel).

Enforcement of the code began on the state's own initiative in August 2026, the [attorney general instructing judicial police officers to open cases proprio motu](2026-08-17-acp-drc-judicial-police-digital-offences). A code that reaches content offences and is enforced without complaint is a different instrument in practice from one that protects systems.

progress: No change, a standing position the repository holds for the first time
summary: The [2018 statute governs payment systems, payment instruments and electronic money and makes the central bank the supervisory authority](2018-07-09-rdc-loi-18-019-systemes-paiement); the bank legislates under it by instruction.
developments:
The statute runs to [139 articles across eight titles; its third article defines electronic money and the electronic payment instrument, and it makes the central bank the supervisory and regulatory authority over payment systems and instrument issuers](2018-07-09-rdc-loi-18-019-systemes-paiement).

The bank continues to add to it by instruction rather than by amendment: a [pricing-schedule notice of 31 October 2025 applies to financial intermediaries including electronic money establishments](2025-10-31-rdc-bcc-instruction-60-grille-tarifaire), and the notice's own operative text is not held, the regulator's page exposing only its title, date and scope.

What the statute has not produced is a modernisation programme: the bank [instructed its technical services in September 2026 to draw up a roadmap for modernising the national payments system](2026-09-04-cod-le-pari-de-la-banque-centrale-pour-moderniser-le-systeme-de), eight years on.

progress: No change, a standing position the repository holds for the first time
summary: The [Digital Code defines interoperability among its terms](2023-03-13-rdc-ordonnance-loi-23-010-code-numerique); the platform it would govern is [specified on paper only](2026-05-06-drc-seeks-consultant-digital-transformation-dpi-biometricupdate).
developments:
The code's [definitions include interoperability alongside cybercrime, cybersecurity, electronic commerce and cryptology](2023-03-13-rdc-ordonnance-loi-23-010-code-numerique). A definition is not a duty: nothing in the repository shows the code compelling any administration to expose data or to consume another's.

What would run under it does not exist. The data-sharing platform and government payment gateway are [specified on paper only, with no architecture, pilot, operator or date, and the interoperability framework is itself a consultant deliverable](2026-05-06-drc-seeks-consultant-digital-transformation-dpi-biometricupdate).

The one place a conformance duty is actually imposed is sectoral: [hospital information systems must demonstrate conformity to named health data-exchange, imaging and interface standards and to the national health identifier and enterprise architecture](2026-06-16-rdc-homologation-sih-anicns-congoquotidien).

progress: No change, a standing position the repository holds for the first time
summary: There is no artificial-intelligence instrument: the [national strategy was validated on 4 August 2026 and not adopted](2026-08-05-rdc-unesco-snia-psen-validation), and officials say the bodies acting on it [have roles not yet articulated in a common steering architecture](2026-07-23-drc-responsible-ai-use-kinshasa-workshop).
developments:
The strategy was [validated together with the sectoral digital economy policy at a ceremony on 4 August 2026, developed with support from the United Nations education and culture agency including a readiness-assessment report, with a mixed commission established by ministerial order in October 2025](2026-08-05-rdc-unesco-snia-psen-validation). Validated is not adopted, and a strategy is not a regulation.

Its own draft rests on [four pillars — governance, ethics, trust and regulation; data, digital and energy infrastructure; human capital, research and innovation; industrialisation and value creation](2026-07-30-rdc-strategie-nationale-ia-validation-technique).

2026-07-23 - officials put on the record that [bodies already acting across digital, research, data, cybersecurity and regulation have roles not yet sufficiently articulated in a common steering architecture](2026-07-23-drc-responsible-ai-use-kinshasa-workshop) — the state's own account of why no instrument has issued.

The Digital Code, the only statute in the field, [does not reach artificial intelligence in its scoping article](2023-03-13-rdc-ordonnance-loi-23-010-code-numerique).

progress: No change, a standing position the repository holds for the first time
summary: Electronic commerce is [scoped and defined by the Digital Code of March 2023](2023-03-13-rdc-ordonnance-loi-23-010-code-numerique), with the authorisation regime for digital services set by [order in March 2026](2026-03-17-rdc-arrete-004-2026-autorisation-activites-numeriques).
developments:
The code [scopes itself to digital activities and services, electronic writings and trust-service providers and digital content, and defines electronic commerce among its terms](2023-03-13-rdc-ordonnance-loi-23-010-code-numerique). It is the whole of the primary law.

2026-03-17 - an order [sets the authorisation regime for digital services and activities](2026-03-17-rdc-arrete-004-2026-autorisation-activites-numeriques), and the regulator separately published procedures for authorisation and declaration of personal data processing in May 2026.

The trust layer the code provides for is not built: the [national electronic certification authority is named and not established, while a July 2026 interministerial order already prices qualified trust services at US$30,000 for foreign and US$10,000 for local providers](2026-07-29-drc-kibassa-launches-strategic-framework-digital-transformation) — a fee schedule for a service no domestic body can yet supply.

summary: The only conformance duty is sectoral: [hospital information systems must be homologated against named health data-exchange, imaging and interface standards](2026-06-16-rdc-homologation-sih-anicns-congoquotidien). No national standard exists.
developments:
2026-06-16 - the health digital agency made [homologation of hospital information systems mandatory under a ministerial order of 11 March 2025, requiring candidate systems to demonstrate conformity to named standards for health data exchange, medical imaging and application interfaces, and to the national health identifier and the digital health enterprise architecture](2026-06-16-rdc-homologation-sih-anicns-congoquotidien). It is the only instrument in the repository naming a standard and requiring conformity to it.

Nothing equivalent exists across sectors. The [interoperability framework is a consultant deliverable inside a project whose consultant is not yet appointed](2026-05-06-drc-seeks-consultant-digital-transformation-dpi-biometricupdate), and the Digital Code carries interoperability as a definition rather than an obligation.

The nearest thing to a cross-cutting standards act is classification rather than exchange: a [national regime of four classification levels with access limited to cleared agents, traceability of transmissions, reinforced archiving and a ban on sending sensitive documents over private messaging](2026-03-20-regime-classification-documents-officiels-actualite).

summary: International bandwidth stood at [6 kbit/s per internet user in 2020](2023-12-01-itu-drc-digital-development-dashboard); one operator [activated an initial 200 Gbps of submarine capacity on 18 December 2025](2025-12-19-airtel-drc-2africa-cable-activation). No later per-user figure is published.
developments:
The reference statistical profile is the only per-user measurement the repository holds: [international bandwidth 6 kbit/s per internet user in 2020, mobile network coverage 75 per cent in 2022 and 27 per cent of individuals using the internet in the same year](2023-12-01-itu-drc-digital-development-dashboard).

2025-12-18 - one operator became the [first in the country to bring the first phase of a submarine cable into service, activating an initial 200 Gbps of international capacity](2025-12-19-airtel-drc-2africa-cable-activation).

2026-09-09 - the eastern half of the country was tied into a terrestrial corridor to the Indian Ocean: a [2,000 km route is live and carrying traffic](2026-09-09-techtrendske-paratus-east-africa-connectivity-itw).

Two new routes and no updated per-user figure: the improvement is real and cannot be sized against the 2020 baseline.

summary: No separate government recovery site is evidenced; the [state data centre at about 400 kVA is the only facility](2025-07-24-sgptntic-visite-data-center-gouvernement), and a [health data centre with a backup site went to expressions of interest in June 2026](2026-06-16-anicns-ami-data-center-national-sante).
developments:
The government's own account of the state facility gives its capacity at about 400 kVA and records that [the law requires all public-administration data to be hosted there while some data still sits on private servers](2025-07-24-sgptntic-visite-data-center-gouvernement). No operational, geographically separate government backup or disaster-recovery site is evidenced anywhere in the record.

2026-06-16 - the health digital agency opened an [expression-of-interest notice for a national health data centre built as a public-private partnership, specifying a main site in the capital plus a backup site, 99.9 per cent availability and a redundant architecture](2026-06-16-anicns-ami-data-center-national-sante), closing 12 July 2026. It is the clearest movement toward off-site backup anywhere in the public estate and it is at procurement.

The commercial market is further ahead than the state: a [carrier-neutral facility in the capital is tier-certified at 400 racks over 1,542 square metres and 1.5 MW](2025-10-31-mbtp-raxio-datacenter-actualite), and the [sovereign government cloud has no hosting location, operator, procurement or date](2026-07-29-drc-kibassa-launches-strategic-framework-digital-transformation).

summary: Installed capacity reached [3,646.5 MW in 2024, 88.2 per cent hydroelectric](2025-03-30-are-rapport-annuel-2024), and the state [pitched its largest hydro site as a location for artificial-intelligence data centres](2025-10-19-moneyweb-congo-inga-hydro-ai-data-centers). No data-centre standard exists.
developments:
The regulator's 2024 annual report states [installed capacity reached 3,646.5 MW in 2024, up from 2,972 MW in 2020, 88.2 per cent hydroelectric, with a further 4,125.1 MW of approved projects pending](2025-03-30-are-rapport-annuel-2024). No data-centre-specific power or water sufficiency standard is stated anywhere in it.

2025-10 - at a Washington investment forum the hydropower development agency [pitched the country's largest hydro site, 44 GW of theoretical potential against under 2 GW currently produced, together with river cooling water and nearby fibre, as a location for artificial-intelligence data centres, a financier confirming a US$1 billion commitment to the next phase](2025-10-19-moneyweb-congo-inga-hydro-ai-data-centers).

At the same forum a memorandum was signed for a [1,150 km, US$1.5 billion, 1,200 MW cross-border transmission line from Angola targeted for 2029, aimed principally at the mining belt](2025-10-16-mitrelli-hydro-link-angola-drc-power-line).

Both are prospectuses. No data centre in the country has a published supply arrangement, guaranteed capacity or tariff.

summary: Two commissionings — a [178 MW turbine ramped to full output by 25 November 2025](2025-11-25-ivanhoe-mines-inga-ii-turbine-5-rampup) and a [substation energised at Kikwit in May 2026](2026-05-05-snel-fourniture-electricite-kikwit) — against no published national interruption index.
developments:
2025-11-25 - a refurbished 178 MW turbine at the second Inga plant, following a decade-long partnership between the state utility and a mining company, was [synchronised in the fourth quarter of 2025 and ramped to about 180 MW delivered into the national grid, feeding both a mining complex and general supply](2025-11-25-ivanhoe-mines-inga-ii-turbine-5-rampup).

2026-05 - the utility [energised a 66/33 kV substation at Kikwit from a hydroelectric plant, attended by the head of state, intended to reduce outages in that city](2026-05-05-snel-fourniture-electricite-kikwit).

Against them there is no measurement. The regulator's 2023 report [lists a section on performance indicators for operators in its own contents](2024-07-01-are-rapport-annuel-2023) and the capture does not reach its body, so no consolidated national interruption index is confirmed at any date. Rural provision runs on a separate track: [22 of the rural electrification agency's 65-project portfolio moved from construction into operation](2026-02-02-anser-22-centrales-phase-exploitation).

summary: The project unit had [core staff in place with recruitment and key deliverables still in progress and several moderately satisfactory ratings](2025-07-18-worldbank-ptn-rdc-mission-appui-aide-memoire); an [accelerated timetable was set in February 2026](2026-02-17-primature-acceleration-transformation-numerique-banque-mondiale).
developments:
2025-07 - the financier and a development agency's implementation-support mission recorded [the project unit with core staff in place — coordinator, finance, accounting, technical — while recruitment and key deliverables, the fibre backbone strategy, the government network, the electronic government architecture and digital skills, were still in progress, with several performance ratings of moderately satisfactory and documented delays](2025-07-18-worldbank-ptn-rdc-mission-appui-aide-memoire).

2026-02-17 - the prime minister's office and a financier delegation [set an accelerated implementation timetable targeting fibre reinforcement and internet extension to underserved zones by September 2026](2026-02-17-primature-acceleration-transformation-numerique-banque-mondiale).

Capacity is being measured only through one project's delivery. No count of technical staff in the administration, no vacancy rate and no skills assessment is published, and the national technical-capacity base is not held.

summary: A memorandum of [13 August 2026 envisages integrating the national identity platform into a bank's customer-identification journeys, subject to regulation](2026-08-13-drc-equity-bcdc-digital-economy-ministry-mou). It is a framework, not a live integration.
developments:
The platform it would plug into [launched on 13 June 2026 on a phased rollout that trains agents before registering citizens, offering authentication, electronic signature, document verification and bank and mobile-money identity as its service set](2026-06-13-rdc-pass-plateforme-identite-numerique-nationale), with no enrolment figure published.

2026-08-13 - the digital economy ministry and a commercial bank [signed a memorandum envisaging integration of the identity platform into banking customer-identification and verification journeys, subject to regulation, and covering digital identity and artificial-intelligence integration](2026-08-13-drc-equity-bcdc-digital-economy-ministry-mou). It is a cooperation framework with no committed sum and no live integration.

Nothing else consumes it. No public service, no operator and no other bank is stated to verify identity against the platform, and the [data-sharing platform that would carry such a query is specified on paper only](2026-05-06-drc-seeks-consultant-digital-transformation-dpi-biometricupdate).

summary: Health is where exchange actually happens: an [analysis application was integrated directly into the national health data platform](2026-06-10-icap-hiv-insight-dashboard-drc) and an [outbreak tracker was configured within 24 hours in May 2026](2026-06-02-dhis2-africa-cdc-ebola-outbreak-response-toolkit).
developments:
2026-02 - a donor-funded analysis application was [built and integrated directly within the national health data platform, letting any user analyse HIV data in granular real time without exporting to a spreadsheet, first adopted as the primary provincial analysis tool in one province with training planned for 112 managers across all 26 provinces](2026-06-10-icap-hiv-insight-dashboard-drc).

2026-05 - after an Ebola outbreak was declared, the national implementing partner [adapted and made operational a tracker configuration within 24 hours for alert notification, case investigation, laboratory-result management and contact tracing, and a joint standardised surveillance and outbreak-response toolkit was validated with the continental health agency, unifying disease-surveillance data flow across countries](2026-06-02-dhis2-africa-cdc-ebola-outbreak-response-toolkit).

The same outbreak pulled in a source outside the health system entirely: [anonymised mobile-phone call records are being used to map population movement and anticipate where the outbreak will spread](2026-09-03-reuters-drc-ebola-mobile-phone-mobility-flowminder). That is the repository's clearest instance of cross-sector data reaching a health decision, and it runs through an international non-profit rather than a state exchange layer.

summary: The education system was [assessed against continental norms and standards over three days in May 2026, with gaps identified and a national roadmap still to be defined](2026-05-12-au-iped-emis-self-assessment-drc).
developments:
2026-05-12 - a workshop under the continental education institute ran a [self-assessment of the education management information system against continental norms and standards, establishing that the system exists and was still being measured against them, with gaps being identified and a national roadmap still to be defined](2026-05-12-au-iped-emis-self-assessment-drc). The national health data platform was being explored as a possible platform for education-data interoperability and is not adopted.

Underneath the assessment there is a working collector: the [national school-data application was used for the 2022/23 school census across ten project provinces](2024-11-01-worldbank-restructuring-eesse-education-project), and a [three-week digital enrolment pilot across 20 primary schools in April 2026 registered 8,634 students](2026-08-04-corus-eduser-pilote-kasai-donnees-education).

Collection is not exchange. No flow between the education system and any other government system is evidenced, and no standard has been adopted for one.

summary: A [consultancy tendered in April 2026 will assess civil registration digitalisation and design integration with health and education data](2026-04-25-undp-cod-crvs-strategic-innovation-consultant). Nothing links a birth registration to the identity platform.
developments:
2026-04-25 - a United Nations tender for a national consultant [frames civil registration and vital statistics systems as foundational digital public infrastructure for legal identity, and scopes a rapid assessment of the country's current digitalisation status, design of digital tools including mobile registration and integration with health and education data, and engagement with the interior ministry and civil-status authorities](2026-04-25-undp-cod-crvs-strategic-innovation-consultant). It is a consultancy at tender.

The identity platform it would connect to [launched in June 2026 with no enrolment figure published](2026-06-13-rdc-pass-plateforme-identite-numerique-nationale), and the population file beside it is [digitalising the capital's register from November 2025, with communal agents being trained on digitalised enumeration by August 2026](2025-11-04-radiookapi-debut-digitalisation-registre-population-kinshasa).

At the registration end the position is worse than partial: one rural eastern sector went [several months without birth registers and stopped newborn registration outright](2026-07-25-cd-walikale-registres-naissance-identite). A link cannot be built to a registration that does not happen.

summary: The standing instrument is a [2021 central bank instruction on handling customer complaints](2021-11-26-bcc-instruction-39-gestion-plaintes-clientele); a [national complaints platform covering banks, telecoms and other regulated sectors launched in May 2026](2026-05-02-acp-loba-plateforme-plaintes-consommateurs).
developments:
The instruction to credit establishments and microfinance institutions is [the principal complaints and redress instrument for banks, microfinance institutions and electronic money issuers, applicable pending a standalone consumer-protection law for financial technology](2021-11-26-bcc-instruction-39-gestion-plaintes-clientele). The regulator's page exposes its title, date and applicable-entity categories and links to a document whose operative text is not held, so the duties it imposes are not established.

2026-05 - the competition commission under the national economy ministry [launched a chatbot and digital complaints-management tool expressly covering banks, insurance, telecommunications, air transport, pharmaceuticals and food, public health and electricity](2026-05-02-acp-loba-plateforme-plaintes-consommateurs). It is a redress channel reaching the sectors digital payment runs through.

No complaint volume, response duty or resolution figure is published for either, and no standalone consumer-protection statute for financial technology exists.

summary: The register runs under the [Family Code as amended in 2016, which structures the civil status offices and governs the birth, marriage and death registers](2016-07-15-rdc-loi-16-008-code-famille-etat-civil). Delivery is not uniform: one sector [stopped newborn registration outright](2026-07-25-cd-walikale-registres-naissance-identite).
developments:
The statute [creates and structures the principal and secondary civil status offices at commune, sector, chiefdom and diplomatic-post level, and governs the birth, marriage and death registers themselves](2016-07-15-rdc-loi-16-008-code-famille-etat-civil). The capture runs through the opening of the register-keeping provisions.

What it provides for is not uniformly delivered. One rural eastern sector went [several months without birth registers and stopped registering newborns outright, the province promising resupply with no date](2026-07-25-cd-walikale-registres-naissance-identite) — a register that has run out of paper is not a partial register but an absent one.

2026-04 - the movement toward digitalisation is a consultancy: a tender to [assess the current digitalisation status, design mobile registration and integration with health and education data, and engage the interior ministry and civil-status authorities](2026-04-25-undp-cod-crvs-strategic-innovation-consultant). No registration rate, office count or digitised-record figure is published.

summary: There is no national address register: a [postal-code directory was launched in 2021-22](2023-07-02-scpt-reforme-postale-codes-postaux), a [utility database of over 800,000 households was shared with the capital in April 2026](2026-04-24-numerico-convention-kinshasa-regideso-mutualisation-donnees), and one commune [began fixing numbered plates with codes](2026-07-31-acp-kintambo-plaques-numerotation-parcellaire-qr).
developments:
The postal operator [set up an addressing plan and launched a postal-code directory during a period it dates 2021 to 2022](2023-07-02-scpt-reforme-postale-codes-postaux), the article giving no more precise date than that window.

2026-04-24 - the capital city and the water utility [signed a convention to share and mutualise the utility's database of over 800,000 households and dwellings for property, land and rental-income tax identification, brokered by the presidency's digital development agency](2026-04-24-numerico-convention-kinshasa-regideso-mutualisation-donnees) — an operational utility database converted into a cross-institutional addressing asset, and a tax instrument before it is a civic one.

2026-07-31 - one commune of the capital [began fixing parcel-numbering plates carrying a scannable code, stated purpose rapid address identification, traceability and administrative management, aiding emergency services and delivery](2026-07-31-acp-kintambo-plaques-numerotation-parcellaire-qr).

Three partial arrangements, one city. No national coverage figure exists because no national register does.

summary: The statute [assigns the commission the mandate to establish, publish and maintain the register](2016-07-22-rdc-loi-04-028-16-007-identification-enrolement-electeurs); its own renewal roadmap [had not been executed a year after publication](2026-03-15-actualite-non-execution-feuille-route-ceni).
developments:
The coordinated text of the 2004 statute as amended in 2016 [assigns the electoral commission the mandate to organise voter identification and enrolment and to establish, publish and maintain the register, makes registration a civic duty and sets eligibility and operational structures](2016-07-22-rdc-loi-04-028-16-007-identification-enrolement-electeurs).

2026-03-15 - the renewal has not happened. The commission's own 2025-2029 roadmap planned [identification and enrolment in a pilot province between April and October 2025, and as of March 2026 it had not been executed, on the record of two election-observation coordinators, with the constitutional timetable for 2028 named as the risk](2026-03-15-actualite-non-execution-feuille-route-ceni).

No register size, revision result or enrolment figure is published at any date, so the gap between the statutory duty and the delivery cannot be measured, only observed.

summary: The tax number instituted in [2003 is the sole identifier for tax purposes](2003-07-18-rdc-decret-03-012-numero-impot); the directorate [confirmed in December 2025 that registration is free and online, denying claims it was being sold](2025-12-02-dgi-communique-gratuite-immatriculation-nif).
developments:
The founding decree [institutes the number and makes it the sole identifier for tax purposes, delegating the conditions of its attribution to ministerial order](2003-07-18-rdc-decret-03-012-numero-impot). It underlies the general taxpayer register and today's online registration service.

2025-12-02 - the tax directorate issued a communique [confirming that registration is free, transparent and accessible, directing applicants to the online platform or to tax offices, and formally denying circulating claims that the number was being sold](2025-12-02-dgi-communique-gratuite-immatriculation-nif). A registry integrity statement of that kind is itself evidence of what was happening at the counter.

The register's role widened at the same moment: standardised electronic invoicing became [mandatory from 1 December 2025 for firms liable to value-added tax, issued through a device connected to the tax administration and mandatorily carrying the vendor's and client's tax numbers](2026-08-06-cod-facture-normalisee-fwamba), which extends the register from identification to transaction-level traceability. No count of registered taxpayers is published.

summary: The systems were [built under the eastern recovery project, whose closure report is dated 12 December 2025](2025-12-12-worldbank-icr-step-eastern-recovery-project); the register they produced has [no decree text, operator or household enrolment published](2025-07-27-adoption-decret-registre-social-unique-actualite).
developments:
The financier's closure report records the eastern recovery project as [the operation that built the country's social-protection management information foundations under the social affairs ministry, including the single social register](2025-12-12-worldbank-icr-step-eastern-recovery-project). The capture reaches the front matter and project-history sections and not the results and registration-count sections, so no enrolment figure is held from it.

What the project left behind is thinly documented: the register has [no promulgated decree text, no operator, no household enrolment figure and no link to the identification office](2025-07-27-adoption-decret-registre-social-unique-actualite).

Payment of the people it would identify runs on a separate and unfinished track: rural civil-servant payroll is [scoped to three named territories and others where no other bank operates, with August 2026 named as a target and the state contract unsigned](2026-07-25-drc-rural-civil-servant-payroll-technical-harmonisation).

summary: Four justice systems are [institutionalised rather than piloted, with case-management use made mandatory by the judiciary's governing council](2025-08-20-undp-transition-justice-congolaise-onu-suede); [33 commercial-court procedure maps were validated in July 2026](2026-07-17-transforme-dematerialisation-justice-commerciale).
developments:
The standing position covers [magistrates, judicial-activity case management, detainee records and the criminal record, institutionalised rather than piloted, with the judiciary's governing council making case-management use mandatory](2025-08-20-undp-transition-justice-congolaise-onu-suede).

2026-06-18 - the justice minister met an anti-organised-crime fund on a justice modernisation programme and [announced the pilot launch of digitalisation at one peace tribunal in the capital and its attached prosecution office](2026-06-18-acp-digitalisation-justice-2-0-pilote-gombe).

2026-07-15 - magistrates, lawyers, clerks and bailiffs [validated 33 procedure maps for the commercial courts over three days, the preparatory step before building a digital commercial-court case-management platform](2026-07-17-transforme-dematerialisation-justice-commerciale).

Two court systems being digitised by two different projects, and no case volume, clearance rate or processing-time figure published for any of the four standing systems.

summary: Digitisation begins with paper: [250 officials, 50 of them title conservators, entered training in archive management on 10 August 2026](2026-08-10-acp-affairesfoncieres-formation-250-cadres-archives), which the ministry calls the operational start of land-record digitisation.
developments:
2026-08-10 - the land affairs minister launched [the first phase of training 250 officials, including 50 conservators of property titles, in archive management, stated as the operational start of land-record digitisation: organising and cleaning paper archives as the precondition to full cadastral digitisation](2026-08-10-acp-affairesfoncieres-formation-250-cadres-archives).

2026-08-25 - a companion course ran [about a month for 50 conservators of property titles drawn from several provinces, with the national school of administration](2026-08-25-rdc-reforme-fonciere-formation-conservateurs-titres-actualitecd).

The legal frame arrived first: the [land and property statute has been in force since December 2025, with a national land plan for 2026 to 2040 and a national land and property register under Senate reform discussion](2025-12-30-rdc-loi-25-062-regime-foncier-immobilier).

No cadastre platform, parcel count, digitisation target or completion date is published. What the repository holds is a statute, a plan and archivists.

summary: A [US$400m credit funds backbone tenders, rural access-network gap financing and pre-purchased connectivity for public institutions](2024-11-19-worldbank-financing-agreement-digital-transformation-project); the [first national forum targeted the 145 territories](2026-05-04-primature-etats-generaux-postes-telecommunications).
developments:
The financing agreement of November 2024 [authorises broadband-backbone tenders, rural and peri-urban access-network gap financing and pre-purchased connectivity for public institutions, alongside an electronic government portal, a secure government intranet and centralised government data hosting](2024-11-19-worldbank-financing-agreement-digital-transformation-project).

2026-02-17 - the prime minister's office and a financier delegation [set an accelerated timetable targeting fibre reinforcement and internet extension to underserved zones by September 2026](2026-02-17-primature-acceleration-transformation-numerique-banque-mondiale).

2026-04-27 - the head of state opened the [first national posts and telecommunications forum, explicitly targeting connectivity of the 145 territories and the urban and rural divide on a 2030 horizon](2026-05-04-primature-etats-generaux-postes-telecommunications).

Against those commitments the backbone stands at [7,000 km deployed against a target of more than 18,500 km, leaving 11,500 km outstanding](2026-08-03-rdc-11500-km-fibre-optique-restants-ptn). No territory-level connection count is published.

summary: Two donor pilots: [patient-record digitisation across a church health network from March 2026](2026-03-10-sanru-lancement-numerisation-dossier-patients-armee-salut) and an [offline surveillance configuration in three eastern health zones cutting notification from days to under 24 hours](2026-04-22-dhis2-community-surveillance-mpox-sud-kivu).
developments:
2026-03-10 - a project funded by a pharmaceutical company and coordinated by a national health non-profit [launched digitisation of patient records for diabetes and hypertension care across a church health network's facilities](2026-03-10-sanru-lancement-numerisation-dossier-patients-armee-salut).

2026-04 - an offline-capable surveillance configuration on the national health data platform ran in [three health zones of one eastern province, with offline data capture for low-connectivity rural facilities and community relays, cutting case-notification time from three to five days to under 24 hours](2026-04-22-dhis2-community-surveillance-mpox-sud-kivu). That measured reduction is the clearest statement in the repository of what digitisation buys at the rural end.

Neither states a facility count against the rural health network, and no national rollout is on the record. What runs nationally is the platform they connect to, not the capture at the clinic.

summary: The national school-data application [ran the 2022/23 school census across ten provinces](2024-11-01-worldbank-restructuring-eesse-education-project), and a [three-week pilot in 20 primary schools registered 8,634 students in April 2026](2026-08-04-corus-eduser-pilote-kasai-donnees-education).
developments:
The working system is a census collector: the [national school-data application was used for the 2022/23 school census across ten project provinces, on data dated June 2023](2024-11-01-worldbank-restructuring-eesse-education-project) — an actual digital school-data collection system rather than a policy statement.

2026-04 - the national student-data service ran a [three-week digital enrolment pilot across 20 primary schools in one disadvantaged province, replacing paper forms with application-based capture and registering 8,634 students, including previously invisible disabled and pregnant or mother students](2026-08-04-corus-eduser-pilote-kasai-donnees-education). Making previously uncounted pupils visible is what the pilot is for, and 20 schools is its whole extent.

No national rollout, device count or connectivity provision for rural primary schools is published, and the connectivity that would carry it sits inside the [backbone still 11,500 km short of its target](2026-08-03-rdc-11500-km-fibre-optique-restants-ptn).

summary: Biometric identification of police personnel [entered its operational phase on 9 July 2026, to be deployed across all 26 provinces](2026-07-09-acp-identification-biometrique-pnc-phase-operationnelle). It is a personnel reform, not station digitisation.
developments:
2026-07-09 - the identification entered its operational phase, [to be deployed progressively across all 26 provinces with the capital piloting first, executed by a private contractor and aimed at a single reliable biometric police-personnel file](2026-07-09-acp-identification-biometrique-pnc-phase-operationnelle).

It reaches provincial and rural posts as an administrative personnel reform rather than as digitisation of what a police station does: no station count, case-record system, reporting channel or enrolment figure is published.

Nothing else in the repository touches a rural police station. The one policing system with reach is surveillance in the capital: [drone surveillance and a citizen-reporting application deployed with no procurement value, legal basis, data-retention rule or oversight arrangement held](2026-01-01-kinshasa-drones-kin-alerte-rdcmonde).

summary: One ministry ran a [fifteen-day digital tools training for central-office staff from 9 September 2025](2025-09-11-edu-nc-digitizing-government-training); another opened [sessions for 580 of its own agents in August 2026](2026-08-24-le-minist-re-de-l-conomie-num-rique-lance-la-premi-re-session-de-forma). No national figure exists.
developments:
2025-09-09 - the education ministry opened a [fifteen-day digital tools and microcomputing training series for central-office managers and staff, tied to its own five-year plan](2025-09-11-edu-nc-digitizing-government-training).

2026-08-24 - the digital economy ministry opened [the first of a planned series of five-day sessions for 580 of its own agents and managers, with no curriculum, completion target or budget line on file](2026-08-24-le-minist-re-de-l-conomie-num-rique-lance-la-premi-re-session-de-forma).

Two ministries training their own staff is the whole of what the repository holds. No national digital literacy rate or skills baseline of any kind is published, so neither programme can be set against the size of the administration or against a starting level.

summary: The [national curriculum framework specifies degrees in software engineering, computer systems and artificial intelligence](2021-12-01-minesu-maquettes-licence-master-sciences-technologie); a [first master's in digital law opened in January 2026](2026-01-06-numerico-master-droit-numerique-upl) and [fabrication facilities went to 40 institutions](2026-05-26-opinion-info-okapi-imprimantes-3d-universites).
developments:
The instrument is the ministry's national curriculum framework, [released for implementation by circular in February 2022, specifying bachelor's and master's qualifications in software engineering, computer systems, artificial intelligence, network and telecommunications engineering and digital communication across public and private institutions](2021-12-01-minesu-maquettes-licence-master-sciences-technologie).

2026-01-06 - the country's [first master's degree in digital law opened at a private university, covering data protection, cybersecurity, electronic commerce, platform regulation and digital governance](2026-01-06-numerico-master-droit-numerique-upl).

2026-05-26 - a national rollout of [three-dimensional printing fabrication facilities to more than 40 universities and higher institutes was launched, with the first deployments at two institutes](2026-05-26-opinion-info-okapi-imprimantes-3d-universites).

No enrolment, graduate or staffing figure is published for any of them, so provision can be listed and not sized.

summary: The national university [created a centre of excellence in artificial intelligence and geomatics in 2024](2024-08-17-unikin-mou-centre-excellence-ia-geomatique) and [awarded its research prize to an applied traffic-governance tool in August 2026](2026-08-29-unikin-prix-ares-kuris-ai). No domestic research funding line is held.
developments:
2024-08-17 - the national university's rector [signed a memorandum creating a centre of excellence in artificial intelligence, geomatics and climate change, confirming its existing master's programmes in artificial intelligence and in geomatics, run under a regional academic mobility programme with six other institutions](2024-08-17-unikin-mou-centre-excellence-ia-geomatique).

2026-08-29 - its transdisciplinary research programme [awarded its excellence prize to a project developing an artificial-intelligence and spatial-analysis decision-support tool for traffic governance in the capital](2026-08-29-unikin-prix-ares-kuris-ai) — locally produced applied research from a national department.

2026-07-09 - a research institute [launched a citizen barometer tracking government commitments and their implementation](2026-07-10-actualite-cd-ebuteli-landila-lancement).

All three run on external programmes or their own resources: no domestic public funding line for digital or artificial-intelligence research is held at any date.

summary: Two civil-society platforms launched in 2026 — an [anonymous oversight platform for extractive revenue on 22 January](2026-01-23-actualite-cd-mokengeli-plateforme-citoyenne) and a [citizen barometer on 9 July](2026-07-10-actualite-cd-ebuteli-landila-lancement). Neither is run by the state.
developments:
2026-01-22 - three non-governmental organisations [launched an anonymous citizen-oversight platform for monitoring the use of extractive-sector revenue on social projects, providing citizen reporting and dialogue with public authorities](2026-01-23-actualite-cd-mokengeli-plateforme-citoyenne).

2026-07-09 - a research institute [launched a citizen barometer tracking government commitments and their implementation](2026-07-10-actualite-cd-ebuteli-landila-lancement).

The state's own participation duty sits in a [2022 decree fixing the rules for budget-policy formulation, discipline and transparency across central government, provinces and decentralised entities](2022-10-29-leganet-decret-gouvernance-budgetaire); the capture reaches its first eight articles only, so any citizen-involvement provision in it is not confirmed.

A standing consultation mechanism for the digital sector was [agreed with an industry network after a tariff dispute, with no constituting text, membership or meeting schedule stated](2026-08-07-drc-digital-tax-decree-does-not-cover-startups-industry-body).

summary: An operator foundation [certified 49 women after a nine-month digital skills and entrepreneurship programme on 9 July 2026](2026-07-09-actualite-cd-orange-maison-digitale-femmes). No sex-disaggregated connectivity or usage figure is published.
developments:
2026-07-09 - the certification ceremony in the capital, with participants also in one eastern city, [marked 49 women completing a nine-month digital skills and entrepreneurship programme, attended by the gender, family and children minister](2026-07-09-actualite-cd-orange-maison-digitale-femmes). It is the only dated gender-focused digital programme outcome in the window.

The national project that would move the number states its objective as [increasing inclusive access to and use of the internet](2024-11-19-worldbank-financing-agreement-digital-transformation-project), without a sex-disaggregated target under it.

Forty-nine women is what the repository can count. No gender-disaggregated connectivity or usage figure exists at any date, so neither the gap nor the effect of any programme on it can be stated.

summary: The [2022 organic statute is in force over a population its own memorandum puts at 13.7 per cent](2022-05-03-jo-loi-organique-22-003-personnes-handicap); two donor builds reach it — a [rehabilitation worker application](2025-11-05-lilianefonds-our-year-in-research-rehapp) and an [offline-first identity model](2026-07-07-itu-wsis-session220-handiconnect).
developments:
The statute [implements the constitutional right of persons with disabilities to protective measures and the State's duty to promote their presence in national, provincial and local institutions, on a six-title structure, its explanatory memorandum carrying a national disability prevalence estimate of 13.7 per cent](2022-05-03-jo-loi-organique-22-003-personnes-handicap). The articles reported to require accessible public information, communication and technology sit beyond the captured text, so the accessibility duty itself is not established from the repository.

2025-11 - a [mobile application piloted in one eastern province equips community-based rehabilitation workers with disability-assessment and client-management tools](2025-11-05-lilianefonds-our-year-in-research-rehapp).

2026-07-07 - an [offline-first system using text-menu access and phonetic verification rather than smartphones, broadband or biometric scans was presented as a model for identity and social-protection payments to persons with disabilities, backed by a coalition including the telecommunications ministry, the ministry delegated to persons with disabilities and the national solidarity fund](2026-07-07-itu-wsis-session220-handiconnect). It is a forum presentation of a model, not evidence of national deployment.

summary: The [only strategy on file expired with no successor formally adopted](2012-09-01-paris21-snds-2012-17); what has moved is the normative frame, with the [continental statistics charter authorised for ratification in September 2025](2025-09-04-actualite-cd-charte-africaine-statistique-ratification).
developments:
The country's own strategy, prepared by the statistics institute, is [the only one the international statistical partnership records on file, expired with no successor formally adopted as of its January 2026 status table](2012-09-01-paris21-snds-2012-17). The capture covers the title page, contents, acronyms and opening context section.

2025-09-03 - the head of state [authorised ratification of the continental statistics charter, the planning minister stating that the statistical system had operated on an obsolete normative framework inadequate to international standardisation requirements](2025-09-04-actualite-cd-charte-africaine-statistique-ratification) — the government's own account of the gap.

2026-08-28 - the council of ministers [adopted draft ordinances modernising the legal and institutional framework for statistical activity, covering collection, processing, production, dissemination, conservation and protection of official data, presented as the country's first legislation on the subject](2026-08-29-opinion-info-ordonnance-loi-statistique). A new legal frame is being built over a strategy that lapsed nine years ago.

summary: Administrative data systems are assessed as [weak, production fragmented, with no population census since 1984](2026-04-17-worldbank-decide-project-pid); a [first statistical compilation from state personnel records was published on 14 May 2026](2026-05-14-fonction-publique-en-chiffres-2025).
developments:
The most recent authoritative statement confirms that the statistics institute [coordinates a system founded on legal and institutional reforms of the late 2000s, and describes weak administrative data systems, fragmented production and no population census since 1984](2026-04-17-worldbank-decide-project-pid). That absence is the frame everything here sits in: administrative data is what the country has instead of a census, and the systems producing it are assessed as weak by the body proposing to fund their repair.

2026-05-14 - the public service ministry's reform unit published the [first edition of a statistical compilation covering nine categories of central-government personnel drawn from state payroll and human-resources records](2026-05-14-fonction-publique-en-chiffres-2025). No periodicity commitment for further editions is stated.

The legal frame is being rebuilt around it: draft ordinances [covering collection, processing, production, dissemination, conservation and protection of official data](2026-08-29-opinion-info-ordonnance-loi-statistique) were adopted in council in August 2026.

summary: The [2012 decree establishes the agency for meteorological observation and satellite remote sensing](2012-10-02-leganet-decret-mettelsat); an [observations financing project launched on 4 June 2026](2026-06-04-meteordcongo-lancement-soff-rdc) and [forecasters were trained on satellite-derived products in October 2025](2025-11-05-wmo-severe-weather-forecasting-workshop-mettelsat).
developments:
The decree [establishes the agency as the public technical and scientific body for meteorological observation, climatology and satellite remote-sensing data collection, succeeding an entity created in 1991](2012-10-02-leganet-decret-mettelsat). The capture reaches the general provisions and the opening of the governance title.

2025-09-29 - a five-day training at the agency's premises [built operational forecasters' capacity to use satellite-derived numerical weather prediction and guidance products from three international and regional providers, under a severe weather forecasting programme](2025-11-05-wmo-severe-weather-forecasting-workshop-mettelsat).

2026-06-04 - the agency [launched an observations financing project aimed at strengthening the national observation network and its integration into the global basic observing network](2026-06-04-meteordcongo-lancement-soff-rdc).

No station count, forecast accuracy or product output is published, so capability can be described and not measured. The country's own earth-observation satellite is [under contract and not in orbit](2026-06-17-spacebel-rdc-sat-contract).
